usedFor: Each new Facebook Lead Ads lead starts a doc, sheet or slide in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Submitted” in Facebook Lead Ads, then “Create a new sheet or doc or slide” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It makes a file per lead in a chosen folder, unlike empty “Create Folder”.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file to anyone with the link, so keep it off lead documents.
